name: Kiro Crew
tagline: A persistent AI workspace that self-improves and connects agents
description: Kiro Crew is a persistent AI workspace written in Python that self-improves over time and connects multiple agents. It gives agents a durable working context rather than stateless sessions, and provides a shared surface for agents to collaborate. The project targets long-horizon work where context continuity and agent interconnection matter.
highlights: Persistent workspace that retains context across sessions
Connects multiple agents on a shared surface
curatorNote: Persistence and agent-to-agent connection are the hard parts of long-horizon work — Kiro Crew makes both first-class, which is why it's worth a look.
